how_it_works: Every capped immigrant-visa petition gets a priority date, and visas are issued in the order petitions were filed. A per-country limit set at 7 percent of the annual total means high-demand countries back up on their own schedules, which is why China, India, Mexico and the Philippines appear in separate columns. Haiti is not listed separately and falls under All Chargeability Areas. Immediate relatives of U.S. citizens — spouses, minor children and parents — are exempt from these caps entirely.
